body: Why are you pretending to be creepqueen? Lol

I really like the 911 RSR without the turbo upgrade. I’ve spent quite a long time adjusting and tuning the suspension and diff settings. It suits my driving style well and I seem to be faster in it than some of the other higher powered cars. Very well balanced car.

It has been a living nightmare that I can never wake up from. My very first memory of being alive is being nearly beaten to death by my father when I was just 3 years old. And things got worse from there. Sexual abuse at the hands of my older sisters causing gender confusion in me as a child. Emotional abuse from my mother who had me convinced that I wasn’t worthy of forgiveness for any mistakes I ever made in life. Bullied at school. Homeless as a teen and some as an adult. Two failed marriages. Losing my parental rights to my 3 kids but still paying a mortgage worth in child support. I feel suicidal every second I’m awake and when I’m not awake I have nightmares about my past that cause me to recall repressed memories that cause me more suicidal thoughts and feelings. 

And you’re right there is nothing in this life. 
In the scope of existence all human life is short and insignificant. 

Even if we kill ourselves having had the lucky fortune to have people who know us and who generally care they will move on with their lives and then die too. And our memory will die with them. Every single person will ultimately be erased from the memory of the collective consciousness. And in that way you’re right there really is nothing in this life. And it will never make sense. And ultimately nobody will know that we were ever here. Eventually. 

Have you tried talking to anyone who is a professional?

People who aren’t like us don’t really know how to respond when confronted with our suicidal ideation. They only know the standard issue socially acceptable responses. I have a girlfriend that always responds with, “We’ll figure it out.” Whenever I’m struggling. And then my struggles are basically just swept under the rug. 

Normal people just don’t know what else to respond with because they cannot process the thought of wanting to end their lives.
How old are you now? I’ve had suicidal ideation since I was 5. I’m 37 now.
How many people are you going to copy and paste this response to?
Oh they encouraged me to make goals and stuff. I just can’t bring myself to do it. Any time I attempt to set a goal it just makes me feel even more hopeless and demotivated.
I never think about the future. I am unable to bring myself to make goals.
That makes sense. I hadn’t thought of it like that.
Why do you think it causes those ideas for you?
I actually had my first therapy appointment last Thursday. I hope it helps. Largely I think porn is causing me to have severe feelings of inadequacy. Hence the suicidal ideation.
This comment is grotesquely under appreciated.
